<article class="tower-card">
  <div class="tower-card-image"><img src="https://tds.wiki/images/{{{image|}}}" alt="{{{1|Tower}}}" loading="lazy"></div>
  <div class="tower-card-info">
    <span class="tower-card-tier">{{{tier|Tower}}}</span>
    <strong class="tower-card-name">[[{{{1|Unknown}}}]]</strong>
    <div class="tower-card-unlock">Unlock: {{{unlock|See article}}}</div>
    <div class="tower-card-cost">Cost: {{{price|Not listed}}} {{{currency|Coins}}}</div>
    <div class="tower-card-extra">Additional: {{{price2|—}}} {{{currency2|}}}</div>
    <div class="tower-card-requirement">Requirement: {{{req|None listed}}}</div>
    <div class="tower-card-note">{{{note|}}}</div>
  </div>
</article>
